title: Fort Hommet

terrainReference.basis: Open original Mapzen field at the tower's landward stone-footing side, with the lower enclosing wall and cliff grade checked independently.

mapIdentity.scope: Mapped Martello tower, enclosing wall, concrete block and Mapzen headland elevations. Two exact original photographs by Man vyi show the surviving stone and concrete profile.

note: The short, slightly battered masonry cylinder stands within a much wider low curving stone wall. A squared natural-stone entrance return and adjoining pale gray concrete block interrupt the silhouette.
